option_relations.rationale: Emulsified silicone oil in a lamellar macular hole is a specific finding that can contribute to or be a component of emulsified silicone oil syndrome.
Lamellar macular hole with trapped silicone oil describes a specific anatomical finding that can be part of the broader emulsified silicone oil syndrome.
Hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole is a specific description of the silicone oil's location and state, which is a component of emulsified silicone oil syndrome.
Silicone oil-induced maculopathy is a broader term that encompasses the damage to the macula caused by silicone oil, of which emulsified silicone oil syndrome is a specific manifestation.
